text: ... [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]].
So this period of Muhammad ﷺ staying with his grandfather [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]], it lasted for two years.
And then when [[Rasulullah|رَسُول الله]] ﷺ was eight years old, [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] also passed away.
So look at this. Look how many people [[Rasulullah|رَسُول الله]] ﷺ stayed with since his birth.
So his father died before he was even born.
Then his mother gave birth to him, then he stayed with [[Halimah|حليمة]] for two years.
Then he stayed with his mother [[Aminah|آمنة]] for a few more years.
Then he stayed with his grandfather [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]]. Now his grandfather [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] has also passed away.
Now he is going to stay with his uncle [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]].
This is the life of a [[yatim|يَتِيم]]. This is the life of an orphan.
And the Prophet ﷺ had a hard life from his birth.
He had difficulties in his life from his birth. He grew up as an orphan, and he grew up poor.
And again, there is [[hikmah|حِكْمَة]] from Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] in this as well.
Why did Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] make His most beloved creation grow up as an orphan?
Why did Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] make His most beloved creation grow up in a life of poverty from such a young age?
So that he could experience it and know what it feels like.
And when he meets people later on in his life who are in those same type of situations, he will know exactly how they feel.
The Prophet ﷺ was the kindest man to orphans.
He was so gentle with them.
The Prophet ﷺ used to keep company with the [[masakin|مَسَاكِين]] and the [[fuqara|فُقَرَاء]], the poor people.
That was his company, because he knew what type of difficulties they faced in their lives, because he faced these exact same difficulties himself.
He knew exactly what they were going through.
So when he spoke to them, when he associated with them, he did it from a place of exactly knowing what they were going through.
So it was of course more effective.
And this is from the [[hikmah|حِكْمَة]] of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] in decreeing this for [[Rasulullah|رَسُول الله]] ﷺ.

Everything in his life had a reason, and Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَى]] decreed only the best things for him, that would be the best for him, and would be the best for his effect on his [[Ummah|أُمَّة]] as well.
[[Bi-abi huwa wa-ummi|بِأَبِي هُوَ وَأُمِّي]], [[Rasulullah|رَسُول الله]] ﷺ.

So after [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]] passed away, [[Rasulullah|رَسُول الله]] ﷺ was now still a young boy, eight years old. Now he went into the custody of his paternal uncle [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]] ibn [[Abdul Muttalib|عَبْد الْمُطَّلِب]].
And [[insha'Allah|إن شاء الله]] next week we will talk about [[Rasulullah|رَسُول الله]] ﷺ and his time period that he spent with [[Abu Talib|أَبُو طَالِب]].

[[Wallahu a'lam|وَاللهُ أَعْلَم]]. [[Wa ṣallallāhu wa sallama wa bāraka ʿalā nabiyyinā Muḥammadin wa ʿalā ālihi wa ṣaḥbihi ajmaʿīn|وَصَلَّى اللهُ وَسَلَّمَ وَبَارَكَ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ]].
